source_and_methods.elevation: B18 derived 0..100 synthetic altitude index, not physical height
source_and_methods.coast_distance: B20 eight-neighbor cell-hop distance from a four-neighbor shoreline definition
source_and_methods.local_contrast: Per-cell arithmetic mean of absolute differences from valid adjacent 8-neighbor heights; compared within a single sheet only
source_and_methods.thresholds: relative altitude <=30 and shore distance <=2 for coastal lowland; altitude <=30 and shore distance >=3 for interior lowland; altitude >=70 for relative highland; contrast in local top 25% for remaining steepness proxy
source_and_methods.basin_criterion: Interior closed-pit pre-screen: at least 3 cell-hops from shore, 8 valid adjacent cells, center relative elevation no greater than all eight adjacent cells. Even a positive hit would be only a one-cell DEM-screen candidate, not a lake.
source_and_methods.important_limitation: The underlying B18 model was already hydroconditioned to drain toward shoreline; absence of interior pits is a property of these synthetic heights, NOT evidence that the real planet lacks lake basins or closed-basin tectonics.

required_realism_checks: Plate-scale extension/compression direction and geological time history require separate author-approved assumptions
Mountain lithology, erodibility, fault geometry and rock permeability must be established before labeling mapped geology
Endorheic basin needs a closed topographic outlet threshold and a hydrological balance before any permanent lake may be concluded
Sediment supply and slope break needed for alluvial fan, shoreline deltas additionally require watercourse and waterbody depositional context
Wetlands require shallow water table or persistent inundation, not merely low grayscale elevation
Rain shadow requires windward aspect, atmospheric moisture and seasonal circulation; H2/B20 rainfall sensitivity weights do not suffice
All confirmed lore geographic relative relations remain binding regardless of uncalibrated model scores
